desc:
You are SKYWATCH, the voice in the air defence bunker. Watch the radar, talk to the pilots and protect the sky!

🆕 UPDATE 3: EUROPE IS OPEN
🌍 Defend 7 countries: UK, France, Spain, Germany, Poland, Czechia and Austria, each with real air bases
🗺️ New strategic map: pick your country, zoom in, deploy
🛩️ 17 jets, new: L-159, MiG-29, FA-50, F-35B, F-47
🚀 Place your air defence anywhere you want: Stinger, Skynex, NASAMS, HAWK, Sky Sabre, SAMP/T and more
🚢 Real aircraft carrier classes, rebuild shot-down jets, shifts of 10, 15 or 20 minutes
🎖️ 50-tier season pass, new missions, new realistic missiles

🛫 A plane stops answering. Broken radio... or a HIJACK?
📻 Real radio calls from pilots worldwide
✈️ Scramble jets and intercept in time
🛬 Close airports, help planes in trouble

Your first shift teaches you everything in 2 minutes. Good luck, Captain!

Bugs or feedback? Join our Discord (link below).
